title: Detailed paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='paperTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d8e6ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='paperSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c4d8f5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fb4e8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='paperFlap' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#eaf2ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b0c9ee'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- under-wing shadow flap -->
  <polygon points='46,58 18,76 30,60' fill='#7ea3d6'/>
  <!-- far wing -->
  <polygon points='46,58 76,26 88,44' fill='url(#paperSide)'/>
  <!-- far wing highlight crease -->
  <polygon points='46,58 76,26 82,38' fill='#a7c4ec'/>

  <!-- body / main top plane -->
  <polygon points='12,34 46,58 88,44 30,26' fill='url(#paperTop)'/>

  <!-- center crease shadow -->
  <polygon points='12,34 46,58 30,26' fill='url(#paperFlap)'/>
  <polygon points='30,26 46,58 88,44' fill='#f4f9ff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- near wing (left flap folded toward viewer) -->
  <polygon points='46,58 18,76 12,34' fill='#9dbde8'/>
  <polygon points='46,58 18,76 26,66' fill='#b9d2f0'/>

  <!-- nose tip accent -->
  <polygon points='12,34 30,26 22,38' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- motion swoosh lines -->
  <path d='M8,60 Q16,62 24,70' stroke='#cfe0f7' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M4,52 Q14,52 22,48' stroke='#cfe0f7' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M10,70 Q18,74 26,80' stroke='#cfe0f7' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
